resources.string: Personal search suggestions appear as your library grows.
Offline speech recognition for optional Korean lyric timing assistance. Model weights are installed separately.
Native bridge used by the offline speech recognizer.
Downloads continue across screens. Wi-Fi is the default, and parallel transfers adapt to your device.
Waiting for network or a transfer slot
Could not complete this request. Check the connection or choose another source.
Public song charts. Albums and artists are grouped by appearances in this song chart, not separate official rankings.
The chart is unavailable. Any previously saved chart remains visible. Refresh requests are limited to protect the source site.
Choose and preview the exact source before saving. A YouTube or SoundCloud performance may differ from the chart recording. Audio is saved to Music/T2Rhythm and joins your local library.
Allow mobile data for this download

Learning and speech analysis run with low device load while plugged in or at 90% battery or higher. A missing model or insufficient evidence keeps the lightweight fallback. Suggestions never overwrite tags automatically.

Optional Korean model: about 87 MB download and 265 MB installed. Download starts on an internet connection, including mobile data. Only lyrics analysis waits for low device load and either external power or at least 90% battery.
Model installed. Analysis continues in short resumable chunks.
Without the model, lightweight suggestions remain available. Manage installation in Background downloads.
Remove only the downloaded model files. Listening history, lyrics and review records are retained.
Review the evidence and listen before applying. Originals and your decisions are kept so accepted changes can be undone.
No suggestions here yet. Learning needs tagged audio and timed-lyric examples, and waits for low device load and either external power or at least 90% battery. Uncertain matches are withheld.
Word timing recognized on this device, matched to lyric lines. Instrumentals and unclear vocals may not yield a proposal.
Timing reused from a matching audio fingerprint and lyric text.
Compared with audio features of locally tagged songs. Unreviewed predictions are never used as training labels.
Estimated from timed-lyric examples, sentence length and the audio envelope. This does not directly recognize singing; listen carefully before applying.
Play this song, then tap a line to hear its proposed time. The existing queue is kept.
The song or lyrics changed. A fresh proposal is needed before applying.
File editing permission is needed. Your original is kept.
